moduleTitle: Module 1. Foundations, Membranes and Cell Signaling

competencies.name: Ion distribution and electrochemical gradients
competencies.can: State the typical intracellular and extracellular concentrations of sodium, potassium, chloride, and calcium and separate the chemical from the electrical component of the driving force on each ion.

competencies.name: Nernst equation
competencies.can: Calculate the equilibrium potential for an ion with the Nernst equation and explain what the sign of the result means for the direction that ion will move.

competencies.name: Resting membrane potential
competencies.can: Explain why the resting membrane potential sits near the potassium equilibrium potential and predict how it shifts when membrane permeability to potassium or sodium changes.

competencies.name: Ion channel gating
competencies.can: Compare leak, voltage gated, ligand gated, and mechanically gated channels by what opens each one and give a physiological location for each.

competencies.name: Depolarization and hyperpolarization
competencies.can: Define depolarization, repolarization, hyperpolarization, and overshoot and label each on a membrane potential tracing.

competencies.name: Membrane potential simulation
competencies.can: Manipulate extracellular potassium and sodium in a simulation and record the resulting change in resting membrane potential against the Nernst prediction.
